summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py (SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path) and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. All 42 tests pass: the 40 new ones plus the 2 existing ones in test/test_path.py. Nothing was committed. mypy, ruff and black are not installed in the generator venv, so the type-check and lint gates were not run; type-ignore placement and line lengths were checked by reading the code only.
